account.overview.title: Account overview
account.overview.description: Your balance, open bets and recent activity. Every figure is simulated.
account.kyc.title: Account not verified
account.kyc.notStarted: No identity or age verification has taken place. This build has no verification provider connected — a licensed one would have to confirm your identity before an account could stake or withdraw real money.
account.balance.title: Balance
account.bets.title: My bets
account.bets.description: Every ticket you have placed in this demonstration. Select a multiple to see its legs.
account.bets.emptyDescription: Bets you place will appear here.
account.transactions.title: Transactions
account.transactions.description: A simulated ledger. Every entry is generated by the app; no money has moved.
account.notifications.description: Match reminders, bet settlements and account notices.
account.profile.title: Profile
account.profile.description: Your account details. In this demonstration nothing is saved.
account.profile.saveNotice: Saving is disabled in this demonstration build.
account.security.title: Security
account.security.description: Password, two-factor authentication and active sessions.
account.security.passwordBody: Choose a long, unique password. A real deployment hashes it with Argon2id and never stores or logs the plaintext.
account.security.twoFactorBody: An additional code at sign-in. Not available in this demonstration build.
account.security.sessionsBody: Devices signed in to this account. A real deployment stores only a hash of each session token, never the token itself.
account.responsible.title: Responsible gambling
account.responsible.description: Your limits and break options, in one place.
account.error.restricted: This account is restricted. Contact support.
account.error.verificationRequired: Identity verification is required before this action
